scope: All44 math tools and54 everyday tools. At least one fixture per tool;this is not exhaustive mode coverage.
independence: Generated entirely outside the product checkout using mathematical identities,Python standard library and documented primary-source equations. Does not import,call,or inspect Finflo product implementations.
comparisonGuidance: Exact integer/decimal strings require exact normalized numeric equivalence;do not coerce large integers to Number.
Solutions,roots,modes and factor lists marked unordered may be sorted before comparison.
Field names and mode identifiers are descriptive;adapt to product APIs without changing expected mathematical values.
Validation conditions describe required behavior;implementation error wording may differ.
Properties test genuinely nondeterministic outputs;do not require a fixed random sequence in production.

Some fixtures intentionally specify a convention such as civil calendar month-end constraining,grid tile counting,shoe measurement conversion,or a limited golf estimate;they do not establish complete parity for the tool.
Default tolerance1e-10;tiny-tail and numerically sensitive fixtures override it.
